description: A dark oil painting of an elderly man in a flat cap and an elderly woman in a shawl, in worn clothes, holding out coins over an open red chest full of coins on a wooden table. Papers, ink pots and a ledger lie on the table, and the ledger's cover has clearly legible lettering reading 'PARLIAMENTARY LEDGER'. Through a window at the right a dreadnought-style battleship sits on stormy water, and an orange glow of fire shows at the left edge. The painting fills the frame with no border.
reason: The ledger at the lower right has painted lettering reading 'PARLIAMENTARY LEDGER', and the papers carry printed lines. Repaint the ledger and papers blank, with no letters.
